`Lint & Repo Gates` is red on `690954b7` for one reason and it is not a defect of this diff: the three new `lint.yml` steps run `pnpm check:pm-fleet-write-validate` / `-execute` / `-dispatch`, whose `package.json` rows and scripts live only on PR #19725 (`claude/issue-19701-fleet-write-transport`). This PR is the declared second half of #19701: it lands after #19725 is on `main`, takes `origin/main` (update-branch), goes green, and is then merged by the maintainer's hand (`.github/workflows/**`). No re-run is spent on the current head — a re-run cannot change a missing-row failure. CI reading on the refreshed head `7bae5b51` — dispatching seat (director, summon #27, `session_0129ZpnaBcYZZ51rCvQiXg6C`), 2026-09-22T14:10Z. One new red, root-caused; a patch round is in flight on this branch.

`Lint & Repo Gates` fails at `pnpm check:declared-population-live` (job 106774664131): 「1 of 265 declaring families declare a population that reaches NOTHING in this tree — `check:pm-fleet-write-validate` declares `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, files `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs`」. The family became a wired gate only when this PR's `lint.yml` steps landed on the tree, so PR #19725's own CI could not see it; the derivation reads the path-shaped literal `objectstack-ai/objectstack` in `validate.mjs` as a population declaration that names no tracked path. Green on `origin/main` (`9a6a6088`, `b22e3f76`). Everything else on `7bae5b51` is green (16 success, 9 skipped); the earlier by-design red (missing `check:pm-fleet-write-*` rows) is gone.

Fix, ruled by the seat and sent to the same dev: on this branch, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs` gains the `dispatch-gates: no-path-population -- <reason>` marker (the validator reads no tree population; its input is the dispatch payload through `env:`), the path-shaped literal is spelled so the derivation stops reading it as a declaration, and the same check is run against `execute.mjs` / `dispatch.mjs` before pushing; `pnpm check:declared-population-live`, `check:self-test-wired` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` green locally on the combined tree. One file rides this workflow PR because the gate only runs against the wiring this PR adds; the maintainer's hand-merge covers both.

## 维护者速读(终稿)

席位:总监席(summon #27,`session_0129ZpnaBcYZZ51rCvQiXg6C`),2026-09-22T15:03Z。这是 #19701(方案 1 中继)的 PR A,`.github/workflows/**`,等您人合。PR B(#19725)已于 2026-09-22T13:51Z 以 squash `70dccce0` 进 `main`,席位侧 `auto` 传输在本 PR 落地前保持 direct。

**改了什么**:新增 `.github/workflows/fleet-write.yml`——只听 `repository_dispatch` 的 `fleet-write` 事件;`permissions: {}`,job 单独 `contents: read` 供 checkout;四步:checkout(不留凭据)→ node 22 → `validate.mjs` 校验 payload(经 `env:` 传入,拒绝即失败、零写入)→ `actions/create-github-app-token@v2` 按 `payload.repo` 单仓、`issues`/`pull-requests` write + `metadata` read 铸 token → `execute.mjs` 执行,步骤结束 token 由 action 的 post 步撤销。`lint.yml` 加三个自测步骤。另一处:`validate.mjs` 夹具把 `'objectstack-ai/objectstack'` 改拼成 `${TARGET_OWNER}/objectstack`,修今天 14:10 那次 `check:declared-population-live` 的红(把夹具字面量误读为路径声明)。

**为什么改**:云席位拿不到 App 身份(代理替换 `Authorization`、拒 `/app/**`),您定的方案 1:席位只发 dispatch,写入在 runner 上以 `objectstack-fleet[bot]` 落地;组织内任一仓都可作 `payload.repo` 的目标,无需每仓放桩。

**风险与代价**:私钥只在 runner 铸 token 时被 action 读取,token 按目标仓与三项权限收窄、单次运行即撤销;发送者门禁 = 能对 objectstack 仓发 dispatch 的人,无名单变量;回滚 = 删两个文件 + 撤 `lint.yml` 三步,席位侧读到 `main` 上没有该文件就自动回 direct。⚠️ 探针若因权限拒绝 `automerge_enable`,再加 `permission-contents: write`,现在故意不预授。

**席位意见**:通过。三轮 CI:第一轮红是落地顺序(B 未进 main),第二轮红是 `declared-population-live` 对夹具字面量的误读,第三轮 `dbc820c` 全绿:31 个 check-run,23 success、8 skipped(八个都在 `EXPECTED_SKIPS` 名册上)、0 其他;`Lint & Repo Gates` 通过即 `check:declared-population-live` 在接线后的树上通过;`check-governed-merges --pr 19726` exit 0(3 个路径 0 命中登记册,+168/−2)。开发的一处偏差——不加 `no-path-population` 标记,因该族从 `RELAY_FILES` 继承四个活路径,带标记会与 `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 的活例矛盾——我认可,改拼夹具字面量足够。

**你要做的**:①合并本 PR(Squash);②组织变量 `OS_FLEET_APP_ID` = `5028251`;③App `objectstack-fleet` 仓库范围改为 All repositories。三者齐后我从云席位发一次探针,回读 `objectstack-fleet[bot]` 后关 #19701。
